Ozone Studies in Antarctica during 7th and 13th Indian 
Antarctic Expeditions 
G.SUDHAKAR RAO, S.B.GAONKAR and S.K. PESHIN 
India Meteorological Department, New Delhi 
Abstract 
Ozone programme of IMD, ozone observations and results at Dakshin Gangotri during 
7th and at Maitri during 13th Indian Scientific Expeditions to Antarctica are discussed. 
Comparison with available data of Syowa and George Foster shows that Indian results are 
in agreement with those obtained by other workers. Ozone depletion phenomena at Maitri 
during 1994 is quite similar to that observed at Dakshin Gangotri during 1988.
